It's getting tight around the belt. I'm looking for some help/tips on what I could do about it. I'm not completely out of shape, I do running for cardio, plus a bit of workout on rest of body (squats, sit-ups, push-ups, lunges, ect. depending on day) everyday.

If you have diet it tips, I'll keep those in mind, but I want to know more about the fitness part.

One tip would be to cut the sit ups. If you have weak ab muscles (i.e. office job, not a huge history of exercise), any exercise will just make those muscles stronger and hence bigger. I saw it on myself when I started working out.

The other tip I'll give is about building a routine. If you're having trouble meeting your exercise goals, the most important thing to do is to establish a daily routine. Choose a time when you want to work out. Ideally, it should be the same time daily, which might mean waking up early on your days off or doing less on days that you work. If your goal is 20 minutes of cardio daily, fuck it, start with 5. Even 2 minutes. No day can be a 0 day (meaning a day without doing your chosen exercise). Once you start, you're likely to do go longer than you thought possible. And even if you only do those 2 minutes of exercise, the following day you will have already trained your brain that 8 pm is exercise time, so it will require less effort to get off the couch and into your routine.

Hope this helps! Good luck!
